answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The wharf lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
